title: Libra: the gift you secretly want
old_caption: You choose for everyone all year. The kindest gift for a Libra is someone who says "I picked the place, just show up." Send this to the person who should.

title: Libra: one word for the new year
old_caption: Libra, your word for next year is ask. Ask for the table you want and the time you need, then give people the chance to say yes. You might be surprised.

title: Scorpio: how you love in winter
old_caption: Scorpio, you remember the small things: their colour, their oat milk, their cold ears. That's a quiet kind of devotion. Let them hear the big thing out loud too.

title: Scorpio: the holiday blind spot
old_caption: Keeping a list of who didn't text back over the holidays? It only gets longer. Tell people you missed them, then let the rest go. Close the ledger.

title: Scorpio: the gift that means the most
old_caption: Scorpio doesn't care about the bow. What lands is trust, a small sign that says you're in. Save this for whoever's shopping for a Scorpio this year.

title: Scorpio: one word for the new year
old_caption: Scorpio, your word for next year is soften. Not weaker, warmer. Letting people closer doesn't cost you your strength. Soft is still strong.

title: Sagittarius: how you love in winter
old_caption: Sagittarius loves by making people laugh: the snowman, the voices, the bit. Keep the jokes, and leave a quiet moment after them for the real thing.

title: Sagittarius: the holiday blind spot
old_caption: Honesty is one of your best traits, Sagittarius. At the holiday table, pair it with a thank you. The truth lands softer when kindness goes first.

title: Sagittarius: the gift that means the most
old_caption: Sagittarius doesn't want more stuff. A hand-drawn map for a walk where they pick the turns? That's the gift. An experience beats anything in a box.

title: Sagittarius: one word for the new year
old_caption: Sagittarius, your word for next year is slow. Slow walks, slow mornings, a slow "I like you." Slowing down isn't standing still.
